tools.name: search_tenders
tools.description: Search live public tender previews. Filter by ISO alpha-3 country, CPV codes (full 8-digit codes match exactly, shorter numeric prefixes such as '45' match whole divisions), deadline window and contract value. summary_lang attaches cached AI summaries in that language.

tools.name: get_tender
tools.description: Fetch one tender by its id (as returned by the search tools), optionally with a cached AI summary.

tools.name: summarize_tender
tools.description: Return the AI summary (title + max two sentences) of a tender in English or German. Labelled as AI-generated; the original notice prevails. Cached per tender and language; generating a NEW summary requires an API key (free tier is enough), anonymous callers get cached ones.

tools.name: source_status
tools.description: Live status of connected procurement sources: implementation status, last successful poll and stored notice count. Honest coverage instead of claims. Pass source to check one portal instead of all.

tools.name: countries
tools.description: Stored notice count per buyer country (ISO alpha-3) across the whole index. Pass min_count to drop countries with only a handful of notices.

tools.name: fulltext_search
tools.description: Full-text search over stored tender titles, descriptions, and buyers.
